reviews.title: It doesn’t work at all
reviews.text: I uploaded my photos multiple times to create my avatars and it didn’t create them at all and I was really excited to use it it needs to be tweaked or upgraded to perform better

reviews.title: No output
reviews.text: All was well, I enjoyed the app. I tried generating the Professional  shooting avatars several times with no output. I was charged 1.99 per try anyway, and I know better than to try getting a refund from Apple.

reviews.title: Where's the prompt feature?
reviews.text:
Two reasons that this app is now more boring.

1. You got rid of the prompt feature that allowed us to come up with our own prompt of how we want our avatar to appear. You took our creativity away. Now I can't be an anime character from a specific show or be a zombie. Now I just have to pick from a load of generic categories, that are behind a paywall.

2. Everything is behind a paywall now.

I suggest bringing back the prompt feature for people who want to be creative and have their avatar be something other than the choices you give.
